WITH player_stats AS (
    SELECT player_api_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (team = 'home' AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal) 
                    OR (team = 'away' AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (team = 'home' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal) 
                    OR (team = 'away' AND away_team_goal < home_team_goal) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count
    FROM (
        SELECT home_player_1 AS player_api_id, 'home' AS team, home_team_goal, away_team_goal FROM Match WHERE home_player_1 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_2, 'home', home_team_goal, away_team_goal FROM Match WHERE home_player_2 IS NOT NULL

        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_5, 'away', home_team_goal, away_team_goal FROM Match WHERE away_player_5 IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_6, 'away', home_team_goal, away_team_goal FROM Match WHERE away_player_6 IS NOT NULL

        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_11, 'away', home_team_goal, away_team_goal FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
    ) AS all_players
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT 'Most Wins' AS category, p.player_name, ps.win_count AS match_count
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ps.win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM player_stats)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Most Losses' AS category, p.player_name, ps.loss_count AS match_count
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ps.loss_count = (SELECT MAX(loss_count) FROM player_stats)
